name: Pipestone County, MN
findings: Pipestone County has 52 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pipestone County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Pipestone County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
